SMALL CLAIMS APPEAL CALENDAR OF JUN-09-2004. THE TRIAL IS HEARD BEFORE JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID FLEISIG. NO APPEARANCE BY SUE TRADING CO INC. THE PLAINTIFF OFFERS TESTIMONY. JUDGMENT IN FAVOR OF THE PLAINTIFF SAYEH MCCLENDON AND AGAINST THE DEFENDANT SUE TRADING CO INC. CLERK:DANIAL LEMIRE.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT RESPONDENT MCCLENDON, SAYEH MCCLENDON, BRENT RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SUE TRADING CO. INC. $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,075.00, SEE SCANNED DOC NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT AND AFFIDAVIT OF MAILING FILED
